title: The chosen street on the coverage map
question: On Outreach → Coverage, a street you pick is drawn solid navy (bright aqua at night, the same as streets done this week). How should a chosen street look? I've built A; B and C stay here if you'd rather one of them.

options.label: A: An ink outline round it (built)
options.thesis: The chosen street is outlined in ink, light ink at night, with its own coverage still drawn inside, so you can see what you're about to mark as not done.
options.viewport: Coverage at 1440: one street outlined, its two sides still in aqua inside the outline; the pane's foot names it.
options.risk: Zoomed far out, the outline is thinner than a marker colour would be.

options.label: B: The orange marker
options.thesis: The chosen street turns orange with a page-coloured edge, as the chosen tile does on the Hub canvas.
options.viewport: Coverage at 1440: one street in orange over the aqua ramp.
options.risk: Covers the street's own coverage, so you can't see which side was done before marking it.

options.label: C: A dashed ink line
options.thesis: A dashed ink line along the chosen street, matching the dashed loop of Draw round streets.
options.viewport: Coverage at 1440: a dashed line down the middle of the chosen street.
options.risk: Thin and easy to miss when zoomed out.

options.label: Today: navy
options.thesis: What it does now, for comparison.
options.risk: Hard to tell from streets done recently; identical at night.
